mapper.sql: id, subject_id, subject_name, actionName, actionPath, actionTypeTitle, login_user_id, login_user_name, login_avater, login_user_number, login_role_id, login_role_name, login_user_dept_id, login_user_dept_name, mock_flag, mock_user_id, mock_user_name, mock_user_avater, mock_user_number, mock_role_id, mock_role_name, ip, module_id, module_name, order_id, menu_id, data_id, orderVersion, control_ame, operator_result, font_color, browser, plat_form, system_name, log_content, log_remark, log_date
mapper.select:
SELECT res.* FROM (
(SELECT , 'message_log' as log_type FROM sys_monitor_messagelog WHERE module_id = #{moduleId} AND order_id = #{orderId} ORDER BY log_date DESC, id DESC)
(SELECT , 'control_log' as log_type FROM sys_monitor_controllog WHERE module_id = #{moduleId} AND order_id = #{orderId} ORDER BY log_date DESC, id DESC)
(SELECT , 'system_log' as log_type FROM sys_monitor_systemlog WHERE module_id = #{moduleId} AND order_id = #{orderId} ORDER BY log_date DESC, id DESC)
(SELECT , 'message_log' as log_type FROM sys_monitor_messagelog WHERE module_id = #{moduleId} AND order_id = #{orderId}) UNION ALL (SELECT , 'control_log' as log_type FROM sys_monitor_controllog WHERE module_id = #{moduleId} AND order_id = #{orderId}) UNION ALL (SELECT , 'system_log' as log_type FROM sys_monitor_systemlog WHERE module_id = #{moduleId} AND order_id = #{orderId})
) res ORDER BY res.log_date DESC, res.id DESC

SELECT res.* FROM (
(SELECT , 'message_log' as log_type FROM sys_monitor_messagelog WHERE menu_id = #{menuId} AND data_id = #{dataId} ORDER BY log_date DESC, id DESC LIMIT 1)
(SELECT , 'control_log' as log_type FROM sys_monitor_controllog WHERE menu_id = #{menuId} AND data_id = #{dataId} ORDER BY log_date DESC, id DESC LIMIT 1)
(SELECT , 'system_log' as log_type FROM sys_monitor_systemlog WHERE menu_id = #{menuId} AND data_id = #{dataId} ORDER BY log_date DESC, id DESC LIMIT 1)
(SELECT , 'message_log' as log_type FROM sys_monitor_messagelog WHERE menu_id = #{menuId} AND data_id = #{dataId}) UNION ALL (SELECT , 'control_log' as log_type FROM sys_monitor_controllog WHERE menu_id = #{menuId} AND data_id = #{dataId}) UNION ALL (SELECT , 'system_log' as log_type FROM sys_monitor_systemlog WHERE menu_id = #{menuId} AND data_id = #{dataId})
) res ORDER BY res.log_date DESC, res.id DESC LIMIT 1
